=== config.db files table ===
CREATE TABLE files(
path              TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- full path of the object
display_name      TEXT,             -- friendly name of the object
description       TEXT,             -- more detailed information of the object
modified          DATETIME,         -- modification time (local time)
created           DATETIME,         -- creation time (local time)
content_type      TEXT NOT NULL,             -- mime type of the object. For example:
content_encoding  TEXT NOT NULL,             -- how is the object encoded in this container. For example:
content           BINARY$            -- content of the object in content_encoding
);
